locations.notes: Profile scripts run at EVERY shell start — a documented malware persistence mechanism. Classified DOWN from data: his authored automation, but only backed up for reference and reapplied after manual review, never blind-restored. Covers both PS7 (Documents/PowerShell) and WinPS 5.1 (Documents/WindowsPowerShell) on Windows.
Command history — a verbatim record of everything he typed, which may include pasted secrets, tokens, or connection strings. Treated like credential material: never restored, never searched blindly.

User-writable module directories are auto-importable code (psm1/DLL) loaded into his shell — same trust level as the profile itself. Reinstall modules from the PowerShell Gallery; never carry them across the wipe.
